analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 79.1 to 64.3, confirming cooling from overbought territory. MACD histogram continues to improve from 10.4908 to 1.3691. Trading volume ratio is low at 0.15, indicating subdued activity. Weekly ADX remains strong at 25.5, confirming a clear trend. The 4-hour RSI is at 65.2, in neutral territory. Overall, this is an accumulation phase where a clear buy/sell bias is difficult to establish.
